intent_anchor.user_goal: Prove two clients converge through an authoritative commit boundary before the alpha gate.
intent_anchor.current_priority: Accept G6 only after closing confirmation bypass and independently rerunning authority tests.

claim_under_review: G6-001 Correction 001 closes the confirmation bypass while preserving convergence and forged-mutation rejection.
what_i_accept: Codex independently replayed the confirmed-on-submit exploit; submit is rejected, commit reports confirmation_missing and revision/hash/entity/outbox remain unchanged.
Godot two-client smoke passes 13 checks including the same bypass regression.
Both clients converge to one canonical revision and entity-set hash after a valid explicit confirm flow.
Forged actor/client/owner/direct write, stale revision, invalid schema, altered receipt, event order and idempotency cases remain covered.
Integrated boot, validator, secret/public-bind scans and all six correction receipts pass.
what_i_challenge: This remains an in-process local simulator with no production authentication, transport or backend decision.
strongest_counter_argument: The POC does not prove internet multiplayer, but G6 was explicitly scoped to authority and convergence semantics without selecting or deploying a backend.
missing_evidence: Production transport security, matchmaking, scaling and backend selection remain future HITL work.
The adversarial-review skill references absent schema files, so this object follows its documented fields but could not be validated against that skill schema.
blind_spots: Cross-runtime hash byte parity is not claimed as production protocol certification.
next_action: Run the independent eight-domain 2.5D alpha evidence gate, then request Human Product Lead acceptance.
